postavke.besedilo: Citi's Banking Technology organization is seeking a highly hands-on Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions for Investment, Corporate, and Commercial Banking. This role focuses on implementing scalable, agentic AI frameworks and generative AI solutions within small, agile squads. The successful candidate will operate with an AI-first mindset, emphasizing rapid prototyping, MVP-driven development, and iterative delivery of production-grade AI capabilities.
